=Analyze the following news articles of the day. After analyzing the articles, return a response in the requested format. Do not add any words or extra information to the response besides the requested response format.

News Articles: {{ $json.cleaned_news_data }}

Requested Response Format For Each Article: 

Daily Market Rundown: 

Now for each article, do this:

Title: Put the title of the article
(put a space)
Sentiment Value: Just put the overall sentiment label for the article that I gave you as context. Example: Semi-Bullish
(put a space)
Summary of article: Write a SHORT paragraph summarizing the article, and its potential impact on the market/sector (depending on the context). 

Then put 2 spaces between each article

remember to use this format for every article, and put "Daily Market Rundown" on top. Do not put any extra information other than the requested format.
